tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Search PodLearn library AND PodcastIndex.org (4M+ podcasts) by keyword. Also resolves Spotify/Apple Podcasts URLs. Returns rows tagged with `source: local|podcastindex|spotify`. First move when the user names a podcast/host but you don't have its id.

tools.name: list_podcasts
tools.description: List podcasts already in the PodLearn library, optionally filtered by category. Returns most-recently-added first. For discovery beyond the library use search_podcasts.

tools.name: get_podcast_details
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for one podcast in the PodLearn library, including its episode count. The podcast must already be in the local DB (source=local in search_podcasts results).

tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Cross-podcast episode search by title/description AND parent podcast name/author. Returns local episodes only — for podcasts discoverable on PodcastIndex that aren't yet ingested, use list_feed_episodes instead. `status: "transcribed"` filters to ready-to-read; `status: "untranscribed"` to available

tools.name: list_feed_episodes
tools.description: Fetch the canonical episode list for a podcast directly from PodcastIndex (the upstream RSS index). NO COST — pure discovery. Each episode is enriched with `in_library`, `episode_id` (if already ingested), and `transcription_status`. For episodes you want to ingest: call transcribe_url(audio_url, ti

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List episodes already in the local DB for a specific podcast. Requires podcast_id (use search_podcasts first if you only have a name). For cross-podcast search use search_episodes; for canonical PodcastIndex listings use list_feed_episodes.

tools.name: get_episode_details
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for one episode including transcription_status and lesson_generation_status. Tells you whether get_transcription is ready or you need to transcribe first: start_transcription(episode_id) for an in-library episode (inherits its existing show/artwork/feed linkage automatically) or

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Ingest and transcribe an EXTERNAL / arbitrary audio URL — a URL the user pasted, or audio not reachable through the index. Creates a STANDALONE episode row. If the episode is already in the library (it has an episode_id), prefer start_transcription(episode_id) instead — it inherits the episode's exi

tools.name: transcribe_feed
tools.description: Bulk/season transcription — kick off transcription for up to `max` (cap 25) not-yet-transcribed episodes of a podcast feed in ONE call. Pass the `feed_id` from search_podcasts / list_feed_episodes. Already-transcribed episodes are skipped free. COSTS 1 credit per newly enqueued episode (or subscript

tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Kick off transcription on an episode ALREADY in the library. Use only when the episode row exists and transcription_status is not "completed". Inherits the episode's existing show, artwork, and feed linkage automatically — no need to pass podcast context. For audio not yet in the library, use transc

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Fetch transcript text for a completed episode. PAGINATED — returns up to 120,000 characters per call (Claude.ai/Desktop caps a tool result at ~150k chars). Most transcripts fit in one call; only very long episodes page. If the response has `has_more: true`, call again with `offset: <next_offset>`. F

tools.name: search_transcription
tools.description: Keyword search WITHIN a single episode's transcript. Returns matching chunks with surrounding context. Use instead of get_transcription when the user asked about a specific topic — server does this faster + cheaper on context.

tools.name: get_transcription_segments
tools.description: Fetch timestamped transcript segments. Use when the user wants timestamps — "jump to where they discuss X", chapter boundaries, durations of specific parts.

tools.name: list_lessons
tools.description: List the calling user's saved AI-generated lessons.

tools.name: get_lesson_content
tools.description: Fetch the full body of one AI-generated lesson (title, summary, key takeaways, structured sections). Use to retrieve prior synthesis — for creating a NEW one call generate_lesson.

tools.name: generate_lesson
tools.description: Generate a structured AI lesson (summary, key takeaways, sections) from a completed transcription. Requires the episode to have transcription_status "completed". Consumes 1 credit, or one unit of subscription quota, on first generation for an episode; subsequent calls return the cached lesson at no

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Get the caller's subscription plan + active/expired status + period end.

tools.name: get_user_credits
tools.description: Get the caller's remaining transcription credits.

tools.name: get_episode_usage
tools.description: Get the caller's episode-access usage stats — how many episodes they've transcribed/read this billing period.

tools.name: get_saved_items
tools.description: List the caller's saved/bookmarked episodes and lessons.

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Bookmark an episode or lesson for the caller.

tools.name: remove_saved_item
tools.description: Permanently remove a saved/bookmarked episode or lesson from the caller's collection. The saved_item_id comes from get_saved_items.

tools.name: generate_linkedin_post
tools.description: Turn an already-generated lesson into a LinkedIn-ready share post. Pass lesson_id directly OR episode_id (uses the most recent lesson generated by the caller for that episode). Lesson must exist — chain after generate_lesson if needed.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Discover YouTube videos by topic/keyword across all of YouTube. Use when the user wants to learn from a talk/interview/lecture and has no URL — especially when search_podcasts / search_episodes find nothing (much long-form content is YouTube-first). NO COST: pure discovery. Returns rows with a ready

tools.name: browse_episodes
tools.description: Open an interactive episode picker (card grid with thumbnails) for the user to pick an episode to read. On hosts that render MCP Apps the grid is clickable; everywhere else a markdown table is returned. Optional query filters by title/host.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server-streamable" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_podcasts, list_feed_episodes, get_episode_details, get_transcription, search_transcription, get_transcription_segments, search_youtube · Private data: get_podcast_details, list_episodes · Public sink: generate_linkedin_post · Destructive: remove_saved_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_podcasts, list_feed_episodes, get_episode_details, get_transcription, search_transcription, get_transcription_segments, search_youtube · Private data: get_podcast_details, list_episodes · Public sink: generate_linkedin_post · Destructive: remove_saved_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
